subject: SIGA intake — VM cadence audit packet and exception register
messages:
From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@finquest.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIGA request — VM cadence, SLAs, remediation evidence

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIGA intake and SOC 2 review we need a compact vulnerability-management evidence packet covering: scan cadence (internal and third‑party), patch/rollback windows, SLA for CVE remediation by severity, recent remediation logs for open/high/critical findings for the last 60 days, and any active exceptions or compensating controls.

Deliverables we need by next Wednesday (2026-09-09):
- Single CSV index of scans (tool, date, scope)
- PDF remediation log summarizing CVE IDs, owner, status, remediation ETA or exception rationale
- A short attestation from Redwood security that the timelines below are in effect (see our desired SLA bullets).

If you have a standard template, that’s fine — otherwise a consolidated packet with attachments is great. Copying Legal to validate the attestation language.

Thanks,
Alex Jensen
Sr. InfoSec Manager
FinQuest

--
Note: please include any exception register entries and the owner contact for each open item.

- Kim will export the third‑party scan artifacts; Karthik will validate the CVE ownership rows; Monica will confirm timelines and the exception register; Dev will produce the patch window schedule.

I expect a consolidated packet with attachments by EOD Monday, 2026-09-07 so you have two days to review before your 9/9 deadline. If Legal needs specific wording we can iterate on the attestation.

Sending an internal request now.

Best,

Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIGA request — VM cadence audit packet and exception register

Alex / FinQuest Legal — attaching the requested packet. Short summary and attestation below.

Attachments (stubs):
- vm-scan-index-202608.csv (CSV export: scan_id, tool, scope, start_time, end_time, findings_count)
- cve-remediation-log-202608-202609.pdf (PDF summary: CVE list for last 60 days, owner, status, remediation ETA or exception rationale)
- patch-window-calendar-2026Q4.xlsx (Patch windows and rollback contacts)

Attestation (signed by Redwood Security & Ops):
Redwood Inference attests that for production infrastructure servicing FinQuest we maintain the following vulnerability management commitments: CRITICAL findings — initiation of mitigation plan within 48 hours and full mitigation or approved compensating control within 14 calendar days; HIGH findings — initiation of mitigation plan within 7 calendar days and mitigation within 30 calendar days; MEDIUM/LOW findings — tracked and remediated per regular release cadence or as otherwise documented in the exception register. Scans are performed on a continuous schedule: automated host/container scans run daily, authenticated full‑scope scans run weekly, and third‑party vendor scans run monthly. Exceptions are recorded in the attached exception register with owner and compensating control references.

If you’d like a short addendum with Legal’s requested phrasing, we can incorporate it and reissue the attestation (can be countersigned by our VP Security if required).

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you need any additional exports (raw scanner XMLs, ticket links).

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vm-scan-index-202608.csv (CSV stub), cve-remediation-log-202608-202609.pdf (PDF stub), patch-window-calendar-2026Q4.xlsx (XLSX stub)
